comment: Productive Pi extension manifest for localllma-setup. Pinned versions, reviewed 2026-11-19. No automatic updates; update = PR + re-run doctor/benchmarks.

pi.node: pinned v22 (packages needing node>=24 stay excluded: pi-sessions)

packages.name: pi-lens
packages.config: settings.json packages[]; LSP servers via npm globals
packages.tests: b2-ts refactored correct; +~11s wall vs baseline on small task; required for code intelligence

packages.name: pi-workspace-history
packages.tests: installed with 5-pkg smoke; git repos remain source of truth, history is additive layer

packages.name: pi-todo-agent
packages.tests: installed with smoke; planning stays in skills for small tasks

packages.name: pi-condense
packages.config: settings.json packages[] + condense settings; native compaction stays enabled
packages.tests: 3-turn long-read A/B: full=50s correct; condense off=see benchmarks; disabled by default for short tasks

packages.name: pi-sessions
packages.tests: NOT installed: node engine incompatible with pinned v22; revisit on node24

native.codemode: provided via pi-lens bundle; allowed for read-heavy multi-call work, disabled for parallel LLM fanout
native.compaction: enabled native: reserve 39322, keepRecent 20000 on 262144 coding-cyber-tiel-35b
